entries.word:
-- Do you have any baggage to check in?
-- Yes, one box.
-- Would you please put it on the scale?
-- Sure. By the way, would you please tell me how many kilos of free baggage each passanger is allowed?
-- The baggage allowance is different according to the class of your ticket. What class are you travelling?
-- First-class.
-- For a first-class passenger, the free baggage allowance is forty kilos.

-- How many pieces of baggage can I carry on to the plane?
-- Passengers holding first class tickets may carry 2 pieces within the total weight of 5 kg onto the plane.
-- If my baggage exceeds the allowance, what should I do?
-- If the checked baggage is over the allowance, we will charge you for the overweight.
-- I see. Thank you very much for your information.
-- You're welcome. Your boarding pass and baggage check, please.

definitions.text: 手提行李。行李超重加钱。登机牌和行李票。

entries.word:
-- Is this the right counter to check in for this flight?
-- Yes, it is. Please put your luggage on the scale.
-- Your luggage is overweight. The free allowance for luggage is 20 kilos.
-- Oh, can I keep this little suitcase as hand-luggage?
-- OK, in this way it's just below the limit.
-- Here's your ticket and your boarding card.

-- Sorry to interrupt you. but aren't you Mr. Wu from China?
-- Oh, yes. I am.
-- How do you do, Mr. Wu? I'm John Smith from DJ Company. And I'm here to meet you.
-- How do you do, Mr. Smith? Thank you very much for meeting us here.
-- You are welcome. You must be exhausted after a long journey.
-- Oh, no. It was a pleasant trip and everything went smoothly, so we don't feel tired at all.
-- I'll be your guide during your stay in China.
-- Wonderful!
-- Will you please take your baggage and follow me? The taxi's waiting outside.
-- Fine, let's hurry.

-- Where is the luggage claim area?
-- Go down the escalators at the end of the hallwaym and the baggage claim is on your right.
-- How will I get my baggage?
-- Just check the flight display board above each carousel(/ˌkærəˈsel/（机场的）行李传送带).
-- Do I have to show my ticket to get my bags?
-- No, but double-check to make sure you get the right ones.
-- But I'm a transfer passenger. I have a connecting flight to Calgary.
-- Then you have to bring your luggage to the transfer check-in area.
-- Thanks. By the way, where can I find a baggage cart?
-- It's over there.
-- How can I get this cart out?
-- You need to put a nickel into this coin feeder.(nickel:（美国和加拿大的）5分镍币)

definitions.text: 取行李区域。拿行李。行李手推车。
